indexes.name: learn_performance_corrections_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learn_performance_corrections_pkey ON public.learn_performance_corrections USING btree (id)

indexes.name: learn_performance_corrections_predecessor_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learn_performance_corrections_predecessor_id_key ON public.learn_performance_corrections USING btree (predecessor_id)

triggers.name: learn_performance_correction_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER learn_performance_correction_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.learn_performance_corrections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION objectives_append_only()

triggers.name: learn_performance_correction_no_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER learn_performance_correction_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.learn_performance_corrections FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION objectives_append_only()

functions.name: learn_performance_correct
functions.arguments: p_tenant uuid, p_measurement uuid, p_request uuid, p_expected_review_revision integer, p_value numeric, p_reason text
